examFormat: PLACEHOLDER - not yet ingested. The EJU Mathematics exam is a SEPARATE booklet from the Science (理科) booklet, not part of it. It is offered in two courses: Course 1 (Basic, コース1) for humanities/social-science-oriented applicants and Course 2 (Advanced, コース2) for science/engineering-oriented applicants; an examinee takes exactly one course. The exam is 80 minutes. Answers are recorded on a mark-sheet by digit: each blank box (A, B, C, ...) is filled by marking a single digit 0-9 (or a sign), so a multi-character answer like '24' is entered as B=2, C=4. The Drive folder currently contains one math question file (2021_1question_math_e_1.pdf, English/bilingual) and the answer keys embedded in the Science answer-key PDFs include a Mathematics section listing Course 1 and Course 2 digit-by-digit answers. No math papers have been ingested for this knowledge base yet.
